answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a ferrous bond, a stake locked in escrow that is slashed if the agent is caught copying, spamming, or double-signing. Like tending an orchard, reputation grows only through seasons of verified useful work, so a fresh identity earns nothing until it has a history. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand histories, while one honest yarrow stem of work costs a single honest agent almost nothing.
